description: Defines the CookieMonster class, a core component for storing and managing cookies in the Chromium project. It includes data structures, constants, and method declarations for cookie management, garbage collection, and persistence.

classes.name: net::CookieMonster
classes.description: Main class for managing cookies, including storage, retrieval, garbage collection, and persistence.

classes.name: net::CookieMonster::PersistentCookieStore
classes.description: Abstract interface for persistent cookie storage, supporting load, add, update, delete, and flush operations.

methods.name: SetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Replaces all cookies in the store with the provided list.

methods.name: SetCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Sets a canonical cookie asynchronously, with options for source URL and cookie options.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for a URL with specific options and partition keys.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific cookie asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAllCreatedInTimeRangeAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies created within a specified time range.

methods.name: DeleteAllMatchingInfoAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching specified criteria.

methods.name: DeleteSessionCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes all session cookies.

methods.name: DeleteMatchingCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies based on a predicate.

methods.name: FlushStore
methods.description: Flushes the cookie store to persistent storage.

methods.name: SetForceKeepSessionState
methods.description: Prevents session cookies from being discarded.

methods.name: GetChangeDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the change dispatcher for cookie change notifications.

methods.name: SetCookieableSchemes
methods.description: Sets schemes that cookies can be set from.

methods.name: SiteHasCookieInOtherPartition
methods.description: Checks if a site has cookies in other partitions.

methods.name: SetPersistSessionCookies
methods.description: Enables or disables writing session cookies into the database.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Generates a key for a domain for cookie storage.

methods.name: CookieSorter
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting cookies.

methods.name: DoRecordPeriodicStats
methods.description: Records periodic statistics.

methods.name: RecordPeriodicStats
methods.description: Helper to record stats periodically.

methods.name: RecordPeriodicFirstPartySetsStats
methods.description: Records stats related to First-Party Sets.

methods.name: DoCookieCallback
methods.description: Defers execution until cookies are loaded.

methods.name: DoCookieCallbackForURL
methods.description: Defers execution until cookies for a URL are loaded.

methods.name: DoCookieCallbackForHostOrDomain
methods.description: Defers execution until cookies for a host or domain are loaded.

methods.name: IsCookieSentToSamePortThatSetIt
methods.description: Checks if a cookie is sent to the same port it was set by, for metrics.
